id: title:frankh:remove last seen column from overview

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the MetricsOverview component, removing the 'Last seen' column and its stale warning indicator, potentially affecting the user's ability to see service staleness.
review.reason: Narrow, localized frontend change: P1.F1.H3 removes the 'Last seen' column and its associated warning rendering while retaining other columns. This is a bounded UI behavior correction, not a systemic capability or reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual user benefit or operational impact of removing this column is not demonstrated; the removal could be a cleanup or a feature change rather than a critical fix. No backend or shared dependency changes are observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend UI change. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes LemonBanner and LemonTag imports, and the 'Last seen' column and its associated TZLabel and LemonTag rendering, while retaining the 'Services', 'Metric names', and 'Active series' columns.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the MetricsOverview component, removing the 'Last seen' column and its stale warning indicator. This could affect the user's ability to see when a service was last seen and whether it is stale, potentially removing a stale warning indicator.
